card.name: Overdosage and other label heading words
card.fires_on: The last piece of the word overdosage in 'no reports of overdosage' statements. It also fires on a few other label words such as hypersensitivity, mortality and tasks, and on the gap after 'Gr' in book-review grade ranges.
